```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
Crepido <- read.table('../../data/IDs/Crepido_fish_IDs_all_data_2021Dec.txt')
SamplesWithData <- setdiff(
  sub('.bam', '', grep('.bam$', dir('../2024-10-04/BAM'), value = TRUE)),
  scan('../2024-10-04/BadGuys.txt', what = 'character')
)
Crepido <- Crepido[Crepido$P_code %in% SamplesWithData, ]
Crepido$Date <- as.Date(Crepido$Date, format = '%d.%m.%y')
table(Crepido[, c('Lake', 'Sci_name_CONSENSUS_ID')])
table(Crepido[, c('Lake', 'Sex')])
```

We only have samples with data from Langfjordvatn and Suopatjavri. Most
of them come from *L* fish, and only two from *P* fish. Thus, there is no
point in attempting an estimation of $F_{ST}$ between the two ecomorphs.
If anything, we can estimate $F_{ST}$s between lakes and between sexes.
Dates of collection and dissection are very evenly distributed along september,
2017.

Considering results in `2024-10-05`, we have two putative species, one
predominating in each lake. Thus, the comparison between lakes must also
be a comparison between putative species.

```{r}
structure <- read.table('../2024-10-05/summary.txt', header = TRUE)
sp1 <- structure[structure$K2.1 > 0.95, 'Sample']
sp2 <- structure[structure$K2.2 > 0.95, 'Sample']
unk <- structure[structure$K2.1 < 0.95 & structure$K2.2 < 0.95, 'Sample']
Crepido$Species <- factor(NA, levels = c('sp1', 'sp2', 'unk'))
Crepido[Crepido$P_code %in% sp1, 'Species'] <- 'sp1'
Crepido[Crepido$P_code %in% sp2, 'Species'] <- 'sp2'
Crepido[Crepido$P_code %in% unk, 'Species'] <- 'unk'
byLakeSexSpecies <- split(Crepido$P_code, Crepido[, c('Lake', 'Sex', 'Species')])
null <- lapply(names(byLakeSexSpecies), function(x) {
   if (length(byLakeSexSpecies[[x]]) > 4) {
      write.table(paste0('../2024-10-04/BAM/', byLakeSexSpecies[[x]], '.bam'),
                  paste0(x, '.list'), quote = FALSE,
                  row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
   }
})
```

```{bash}
if [ ! -e Langfjordvatn.list ]; then
   cat Langfjordvatn*.list > Langfjordvatn.list
fi
if [ ! -e Suopatjavri.list ]; then
   cat Suopatjavri*.list > Suopatjavri.list
fi
```

To be run in Garnatxa:

```{bash SAF, eval=FALSE}
ASM=../2024-10-04/radloci.fa

if [ ! -d SAF ]; then mkdir SAF; fi
for pop in $(ls -1 *.list); do
   NUMIND=$(cat $pop | wc -l)
   NAME=$(basename -s .list $pop)
   if [ ! -e SAF/$NAME.saf.idx ]; then
      angsd -b $pop \
            -anc $ASM \
            -ref $ASM \
            -out SAF/$NAME \
            -doSaf 1 \
            -gl 1 \
            -minMapQ 30 \
            -minQ 20 \
            -only_proper_pairs 1 \
            -baq 1 \
            -minInd $(( NUMIND * 4 /  5)) \
            -setMinDepthInd 4 \
            -nThreads 4 1> SAF/$NAME.log 2> SAF/$NAME.err &
   fi
done
wait
```

From the whole-genome SAF files, I generate below the SFS
for a visualization and comparison among populations. We
don't really need individual SFS for $F_{ST}$ calculation,
but we need it for other purposes. This is run in Garnatxa as well,
with the same script.

```{bash SFS, eval=FALSE}
if [ ! -d SFS ]; then mkdir SFS; fi
for pop in $(ls -1 *.list); do
   NAME=$(basename -s .list $pop)
   if [ ! -e SFS/$NAME.sfs ]; then
      realSFS -fold 1 \
              -nSites 5000000 \
              SAF/$NAME.saf.idx 1> SFS/$NAME.sfs 2> SFS/$NAME.log
   fi
   # If the EM optimization is repeated, due to instability detected,
   # more than one SFS is output, in different lines. We need to keep
   # only the last one.
   if [ $(cat SFS/$NAME.sfs | wc -l) -gt 1 ]; then
      mv SFS/$NAME.sfs SFS/$NAME.sfs_multiple
      tail -n 1 SFS/$NAME.sfs_multiple > SFS/$NAME.sfs
   fi
done
```

```{r inspectSF, fig.width=20, fig.height=10, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressMessages(library(ggplot2))
suppressMessages(library(gridExtra))
files <- system2('ls', args = 'SFS/*.sfs', stdout = TRUE)
sfs.list <- lapply(files, scan, quiet = TRUE)
names(sfs.list) <- gsub('(SFS/|.sfs)', '', files)
plots <- lapply(1:length(sfs.list), function(x) {
   SFS <- sfs.list[[x]]
   # I add 1 to expected number of sites to facilitate log transformation.
   ggplot(data = data.frame(X = 0:(length(SFS)-1), Y = SFS + 1),
          mapping = aes(x = X, y = Y)) +
      geom_col() +
      scale_y_continuous(trans = 'log') +
      ggtitle(files[x]) +
      xlim(-0.5, (length(SFS) + 1)/2) +
      xlab('MAF') + ylab('Exp. Num. Sites')
})
grid.arrange(grobs = plots, ncol = 3)
```

## Two-dimensional SFS

```{bash 2DSFS, eval=FALSE}
if [ ! -d 2D_SFS ]; then mkdir 2D_SFS; fi
# In alphabetic order
POPS=(Langfjordvatn.f.sp1 Langfjordvatn.m.sp1 Langfjordvatn Suopatjavri.f.sp2 Suopatjavri.m.sp2 Suopatjavri)
for j in $(seq 1 $(( ${#POPS[@]} - 1)) ); do
   for i in $(seq 0 $(( j - 1 )) ); do
      if [ ! -e 2D_SFS/${POPS[i]}.${POPS[j]}.ml ]; then
         realSFS -cores 32 \
                 -fold 1 \
                 -nSites 5000000 \
                 SAF/${POPS[i]}.saf.idx \
                 SAF/${POPS[j]}.saf.idx \
                 1> 2D_SFS/${POPS[i]}.${POPS[j]}.ml \
                 2> 2D_SFS/${POPS[i]}.${POPS[j]}.err
      fi
   done
done
```

Only three comparisons are meaningful: species 1 from Langfjordvatn
versus species 2 from Suopatjavri; males versus females in species 1
from Langfjordvatn; and males versus females in species 2 from
Suopatjavri.

```{r 2DSFSplot, fig.width=5, fig.height=15, message=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
Pop1 <- c('Langfjordvatn', 'Langfjordvatn.f.sp1', 'Suopatjavri.f.sp2')
Pop2 <- c('Suopatjavri',   'Langfjordvatn.m.sp1', 'Suopatjavri.m.sp2')
SFS2DFiles <- c('2D_SFS/Langfjordvatn.Suopatjavri.ml',
                '2D_SFS/Langfjordvatn.f.sp1.Langfjordvatn.m.sp1.ml',
                '2D_SFS/Suopatjavri.f.sp2.Suopatjavri.m.sp2.ml')
numInd <- sapply(c(Pop1, Pop2),
                 function(x) {
                    length(scan(paste0(x, '.list'),
                                what = 'character',
                                quiet = TRUE))
                 })
SFS2D <- lapply(1:length(SFS2DFiles),
                function(x) {
                   pop1 <- Pop1[x]
                   pop2 <- Pop2[x]
                   matrix(scan(SFS2DFiles[x], quiet = TRUE),
                          ncol = 2 * numInd[pop2] + 1,
                          nrow = 2 * numInd[pop1] + 1,
                          byrow = TRUE)
                })

MainLab <- c('Between species and lakes',
             'C. farionis in Langfjordvatn',
             'C. pseudofarionis in Suopatjavri')
XLabels <- c('C. farionis in Langfjordvatn',
             'C. farionis on female fish',
             'C. pseudofarionis on female fish')
YLabels <- c('C. pseudofarionis in Suopatjavri',
             'C. farionis on male fish',
             'C. pseudofarionis on male fish')
par(mfrow = c(3, 1), mar = c(5.5, 5.5, 5, 2))
devnull <- lapply(1:length(SFS2D), function(z) {
   image(x = 0:(dim(SFS2D[[z]])[1] - 1),
         y = 0:(dim(SFS2D[[z]])[2] - 1),
         log(SFS2D[[z]]),
         main = MainLab[z],
         xlab = XLabels[z],
         ylab = YLabels[z],
         cex.main = 2, cex.lab = 2, cex.axis = 2)
})

par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(5.1, 4.1, 4.1, 2.1))
```



## $F_{ST}$s

```{bash FSTs, eval=TRUE}
# FSTs
if [ ! -d FST ]; then mkdir FST; fi

POPS=(Bie.C.confusus Bri.C.alpinus Bri.C.fatioi Lan.D Lan.L Lan.P Suo.L Suo.P Thu.C.acrinasus Thu.C.profundus Thu.C.steinmanni Wal.C.duplex)
for j in $(seq 1 $(( ${#POPS[@]} - 1 )) ); do
   for i in $(seq 0 $(( j - 1 )) ); do
      if [ ! -e FST/${POPS[i]}.${POPS[j]}.fst.idx ]; then
         realSFS fst index \
                 SAF/${POPS[i]}.saf.idx \
                 SAF/${POPS[j]}.saf.idx \
                 -sfs 2D_SFS/${POPS[i]}.${POPS[j]}.ml \
                 -fstout FST/${POPS[i]}.${POPS[j]} \
                 -whichFst 1 \
                 -cores 24 \
                 1> FST/${POPS[i]}.${POPS[j]}.log \
                 2> FST/${POPS[i]}.${POPS[j]}.err
      fi
   done
done
```

```{bash summary, eval=TRUE}
if [ ! -e summaryFST.txt ]; then
   echo -e "Pop1\tPop2\tFST.unweighted\tFST.weighted" > summaryFST.txt
   if [ -e FST/Langfjordvatn.Suopatjavri.fst.idx ]; then
      LC_ALL=C printf "%s\t%s\t%.6f\t%.6f\n" \
      "C. farionis (Lan)" "C. pseudofarionis (Suo)" \
      $(realSFS fst stats FST/Langfjordvatn.Suopatjavri.fst.idx 2> /dev/null) >> summaryFST.txt
   else
      echo -e "C. farionis (Lan)\tC. pseudofarionis (Suo)\tNA\tNA" >> summaryFST.txt
   fi

   if [ -e FST/Langfjordvatn.f.sp1.Langfjordvatn.m.sp1.fst.idx ]; then
      LC_ALL=C printf "%s\t%s\t%.6f\t%.6f\n" \
      "C. farionis on females (Lan)" "C. farionis on males (Lan)" \
      $(realSFS fst stats FST/Langfjordvatn.f.sp1.Langfjordvatn.m.sp1.fst.idx 2> /dev/null) >> summaryFST.txt
   else
      echo -e "C. farionis on females (Lan)\tC. farionis on males (Lan)\tNA\tNA" >> summaryFST.txt
   fi

   if [ -e FST/Suopatjavri.f.sp2.Suopatjavri.m.sp2.fst.idx ]; then
      LC_ALL=C printf "%s\t%s\t%.6f\t%.6f\n" \
      "C. pseudofarionis on females (Suo)" "C. pseudofarionis on males (Suo)" \
      $(realSFS fst stats FST/Suopatjavri.f.sp2.Suopatjavri.m.sp2.fst.idx 2> /dev/null) >> summaryFST.txt
   else
      echo -e "C. pseudofarionis on females (Suo)\tC. pseudofarionis on males (Suo)\tNA\tNA" >> summaryFST.txt
   fi
fi
```
